game.name: Rock Band : Metal Track Pack (USA)
game.desc: Rock Band: Metal Track Pack for Xbox 360 offers a pack of new rock/metal songs for the game Rock Band. This music game puts you in the middle of a rock band. Using the special accessories, you can sit behind the drums, play the guitar or bass or even sing into the microphone. The package includes 20 new songs, including Children of Bodom, Rage Against the Machine, Lamb of God and Blue Öyster Cult.
